title: Spielberg: UFOs as future humans

tellings.quote: What if they're not from an advanced civilization 300 million lighty years from here? But what if it's us 500,000 years into the future?

plain: The film director Steven Spielberg has wondered aloud whether UFOs come not from a civilisation hundreds of millions of light years away but from us, humans 500,000 years in the future. The remark, made to the talk-show host Stephen Colbert, comes up in an episode with the hip-hop artist Flying Lotus. If true, it would mean the visitors are our own descendants.
